case_title: GARCIA CRECENCIO VS HEJAZI HENRY IND/DBA ROXANNE CAFE

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $5,000.00 FILED BY GARCIA CRECENCIO AS TO DEFENDANT HEJAZI HENRY IND/DBA ROXANNE CAFE ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR JUL-10-1992 AT 08:00 AM IN DEPT 02

PARTIES WAIVE SERVICE ON PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM. THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF GARCIA CRECENCIO IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT HEJAZI HENRY IND/DBA ROXANNE CAFE STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
